SmartButton.description: A rectangular button used in Odoo-style interfaces to show stats directly on the action.
SmartButton.style: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-20 w-32 border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all rounded-sm
SmartButton.content_structure: {count} {label}

KanbanBoard.column_style: min-w-[300px] bg-white/5 rounded-lg p-4 border border-white/5 flex flex-col gap-3
KanbanBoard.card_style: bg-card p-4 rounded border-l-4 border-l-accent shadow-lg hover:translate-y-[-2px] transition-transform cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing

MaintenanceCalendar.style: h-[600px] bg-card rounded-lg p-4 border border-white/10 text-sm font-mono
MaintenanceCalendar.customization: Override default toolbar with custom Shadcn buttons. Use 'month', 'week', 'day' views.

StatusBadge.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-opacity-10 border border-opacity-20

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors with subtle noise textures if possible.
All borders must be 1px solid white/10 (10% opacity white).
Input fields should have a 'font-mono' style for values.
Avoid rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Use rounded-sm or rounded-md for an industrial feel.
Animations should be fast (150ms-200ms) and linear or ease-out. No bouncy springs.
Always use the 'SmartButton' component for equipment stats (e.g., '5 Requests', '2 Overdue').

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Install dependencies: @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities react-big-calendar date-fns lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Update tailwind.config.js with the provided colors and font families.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create the 'SmartButton' and 'StatusBadge' reusable components first.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the Layout with a fixed sidebar and top navbar.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build the Kanban board using dnd-kit. Ensure columns are: New Request, In Progress, Repaired, Scrap.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Build the Equipment Detail page with the Smart Button row at the top.
